title: The Canon of Fixed Law
summary: A canon for students past the courses of the middle grade on striking and standing by laws that do not bend.

title: A Treatise on Binding Statutes
summary: A treatise on holds and seals that follow from written rule so the bound cannot argue them away.

title: The Stability Field Compendium
summary: A compendium on spreading order qi as a living field in which wild force steadies and falls to nothing.

title: Charter of the Measured Wall
summary: A charter on walls of order qi built to an exact measure so that every layer carries its share of the blow.

title: Treatise of Ledger and Seal
summary: A treatise on writing a debt of force into the foe and sealing the account so that it must be paid.

title: The Regulating Hand
summary: A course in the open hand that corrects every flaw of rhythm and posture in techniques near it.

title: The Plumb and Pendulum Course
summary: A course on swinging strokes whose period never changes and falls always on the plumb line of the target.

title: Code of Restored Patterns
summary: A code for setting broken techniques back into their proper pattern and for undoing the patterns of others.

title: Manual of the Level Domain
summary: A manual on a wide domain of order qi where footing is true and force is kept level and fair.
